steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: New Classes
steps.body:
Class books are available here at the Training Hall — more unlock as you open new regions. Assign a book to one of your heroes to teach them a new fighting style.

Upgrade the hall and your heroes train harder — better equipment means a sharper edge on every lesson. Higher tiers grant bonus experience across all your heroes. A sharp mind wins more fights than a sharp sword.
